Composition rights
Underlying composition is out of copyright where the ordinary life-plus-70 term applies. Inferred, not documented

Wagner died in 1883. This is a term calculation, not worldwide clearance of every edition.

[1]
Recording rights
US public domain under the project’s pre-1926 publication rule; source identifies a 1925 pressing. Documented

The Internet Archive item supplies the historical publication evidence, not an explicit free-licence URL. Its 1925 dating is preserved as the source claim; catalogue-number disagreement is disclosed. The US term ends 31 December 2025; no worldwide clearance is implied.

[1] [4]

Wagner: Siegfried Idyll; Modern Chamber Orchestra, Stanley Chapple; Vocalion acoustic issue dated 1925 by the source. Transfer 2021, Animating Apothecary Archives, via Internet Archive. US public domain from 1 January 2026. Rights statement
